correctness.rationale: Direct proof from the full sandwich multiplication: all idempotents have rank one or two; distinct rank-two idempotents commute only when identical, constants pairwise do not commute, and each rank-two idempotent commutes with exactly its two image constants. This proves the repeated-edge subdivision identification. The explicit incidence Gram eigenvalue calculation proves the characteristic polynomial for every n>=2 and all u,v>=1, with zero boundary cases checked. Perron root and vertex order identify n and uv. The n>=4 automorphism classification uses degree separation. Direct full-transformation enumeration for 29 configurations corroborated every adjacency and spectral power-trace identity without being substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The entire commuting-idempotent adjacency relation (not just a vertex count) is an intrinsic object, and its exact spectrum and graph automorphisms distinguish and clarify the rank-two variant family. Complete graph structure provides global adjacency, connectedness, spectral rank and symmetry data, with precise field-free formulas and a spectral recovery principle. This is motivated by the structural semigroup-graph correspondence, not arbitrary parameter slices or a known table recomputation.
